notes.text: They agree for every d and n, but the existential form is what proofs need: to show d divides n you give the k, and from a proof you get the k back. It is also how Mathlib defines divisibility.
Yes. Both are now theorems: Divides.zero (every d divides 0) in this module, and Divides.zero_left (0 divides n exactly when n = 0) in ReviewExample.Zero.
It is the usual convention: every number divides 0, and 0 is the greatest in the divisibility order. divides_gcd states exactly that.
